note: Story mode: tiers open in order; a tier opens when every world in the tier before it is finished. Puzzles in a world open one at a time. Puzzle ids are save keys: a scene path, url:<date>, or story:<name>. Generated from the progression web; edit by hand or regenerate.

worlds.name: Dead Again
worlds.idea: Repeat your cards: Echo plays the next card twice, Rebound returns it to your hand
worlds.story: The basics of reaping: spend your energy, strike hard, and make every card count.

lines: Nobody sails these waters and lives!
I'll change that.
One bite and you'll howl forever!
I'm more of a cat person. Unlucky black cats, specifically.

worlds.name: Harvesting Souls
worlds.idea: Every card you play counts: Overload and Burst grow with each one, Thunderbolt cashes in all your energy
worlds.story: Every card you play feeds the harvest. The more you play, the bigger the final blow.

lines: CLEANING PROTOCOL ENGAGED. YOU ARE DIRT.
And you're about to bite the dust.
I'm all puffed up and ready to fight!
Let's see how you handle a little pressure.
You can't kill what's already dead!
Lucky for you, I'm running a skeleton crew today.
Every soul you take, I take back. Again and again.
Collecting? I prefer harvesting.
RELEASE ME!
Release you? That's literally my job.

worlds.name: Reanimation
worlds.idea: Bring cards back and copy them: Revive and Trace
worlds.story: Nothing here stays buried: played cards come back to your hand, and copies rise from the ones you play.

lines: Brrr-ing it on, Reaper!
Let it go...
Whatever you kill, I bring back.
Then we'll be seeing a lot of each other.
The dead answer to ME now!
And who kills your minions?
Watch closely! I never drop a single blade!
Can I borrow one of those?
I strike twice in the same place!
Then you'll find it shocking when I strike back.
I've got my eye on you, Reaper!
You still won't see this coming...

worlds.name: Ferryman's Toll
worlds.idea: Don't pay full price: Gift makes a card free, Bargain discounts the next three
worlds.story: The Ferryman deals in discounts. Cards get cheaper here, and some cost nothing at all.

lines: Everything's negotiable! What's my life worth to you?
Your life, final offer.
I don't pay for anything. Not even death!
This one's on the house.
I'll be taking that soul, and your wallet!
I don't carry cash... can I pay you back?
I'll give you three coins for that scythe.
... is that your final offer?
Shiny! Mine! Gimme!
Here. Something sharp and shiny, just for you.

worlds.name: Blood Price
worlds.idea: Sacrifice life: pay with health, lose it on purpose, get paid for being low
worlds.story: Here you pay in blood. Cards cost your health, and the closer you are to death, the stronger you get.

lines: Doc says a little bloodletting is better than medicine!
Side effects include death.
Bzzz! Just a little sip!
Buzz off, you mooch. The blood's mine.
Once I latch on, I never let go!
You're worse than the mosquito...
Disturb my tomb and be cursed forever!
I've been cursed at by worse.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. I have ELEVEN!
Take a good look!
I am the mountain. You cannot move me!
Good... stay put for a second...

worlds.name: Six Feet Under
worlds.idea: Dig through the discard pile: Shovel hits for every card in it
worlds.story: Dig deep. The more cards in your discard pile, the harder you hit.

lines: Down here, I'm the one who digs graves!
Ok well, just stay down there...
Badger don't care!
Grim don't care neither...
RAAAAAAAAA!
Ho ho ho, here's a gift!
How thoughtful. Would you like to see what I got you?
I have perfected hole digging...
Uh... well, pretend this is your last hole to dig.
Cut me in half and there's two of me!
Okay... well, I'll just kill you twice?
Blorp. I'm oozing with confidence!
You're oozing, all right.

worlds.name: Dust to Dust
worlds.idea: Trash cards for good: Haunt trashes your next card and leaves the enemy Vulnerable
worlds.story: What's trashed here is gone for good, and it leaves your enemy exposed.

lines: Boo! Scared yet?
No. Wait, yes. Wait, no. I can't even see you.
I cry for every life you've taken.
Okay, well, save one more.
When I scream, someone dies!
Would you like to scream before or after?
Sssso, the Reaper comes for me?
Don't take it personally. It's just business.
Kobold is mighty! Kobold is strong!
Kobold is... about to be very quiet.

worlds.name: Death's Edge
worlds.idea: Sharp: Sharpen and Acuminate add to every hit, wearing off by 1 per card played
worlds.story: Blades are sharpened here, adding to every hit, but the edge dulls with every card you play.

lines: I've taken more heads than you, Reaper.
I... don't think that's true.
My blade is sharp. My honor, sharper.
Mine's sharper. It's a scythe.
Your skull will look great on my wall.
I'll keep that in mind.
I came back for revenge!
Just to die again?
I never miss!
You've got the bones of a good archer. Just the bones.
My arrows are blessed by the heavens!
Ew, heaven...

worlds.name: Coup de Grâce
worlds.idea: Critical hits: Target and Frenzy double one devastating hit
worlds.story: One perfect blow decides it. Hits can land for double, and the most desperate strike hardest.

lines: Any last words?
Funny. That's my line.
*sniff sniff* I smell death!
That would be me.
Freeze, Grim Reaper!
I'm already cold-blooded.
En garde! Only one of us leaves this duel.
Correct.
You can't hit what isn't there!
Then hold still, wherever you are.
You never saw me coming.
I see everyone coming. Eventually.

worlds.name: Second Wind
worlds.idea: Heal up, then cash it in: Mend, Potion, Shield, Drain and Cauterize patch you up, Heartbeat hits for your HP
worlds.story: Patch yourself up, then turn your own health into a weapon.

lines: You can't stop a heart I don't have!
Then this won't hurt a bit.
I vant to suck your blood!
Good luck with that. I'm all bone.
I have a potion for every ailment!
Do you have one for death?
I follow you everywhere, Reaper.
Then you know where we're going.
I put the dead to rest. You keep stealing my business!
Think of me as a supplier.
Life is a tightrope, and I never fall!
Everyone falls. Watch your step.
Cut off one head, two more grow back!
Then I'll work fast.

worlds.name: Plague
worlds.idea: Poison and Vulnerable: Venom and Berserk make every hit count more
worlds.story: Weaken them first: the sicker your enemy, the harder every hit lands.

lines: I've carried every plague in history!
Yuck... maybe I should be thanking you.
Pain is my penance!
All sins will be forgiven...
Down here, I'm king!
Long live the king.
Open wide and say "ahh"... it's the plague.
Doctor, I think it's terminal.
We'll eat through anything!
Ick, good riddance!!
GRRR! I've chased bears off their dinner. You're next!
I'm much worse than a bear...

worlds.name: Cremation
worlds.idea: Burn: Scorch sets the enemy on fire, Forge turns your next attacks into Burn
worlds.story: Set your enemy alight, and they'll burn a little more with every card you play.

lines: You'll squeal before I do!
Oink oink!!!
Fire can't hurt me!
Come here, you slippery thing!
Just one spark and this whole place goes up!
Let's not play with fire.
My heart burns only for you, Reaper!
That's sweet. It's still over.
I'm made of a dozen dead men. Which one do you want?
All of them, please.

worlds.name: Funeral Pyre
worlds.idea: Sparks: Ignite makes Spark cards, and every Spark you play makes all of them hit harder
worlds.story: Every spark you play makes the next one hotter. Feed the fire and it becomes a blaze.

lines: I burn so others may see!
Then let's blow out the candle.
Every fire needs a keeper!
And every keeper needs a reaper.
I always come back!
Not this time.
Bzzt! I light up the night!
Lights out, little bug.
My inventions can't be stopped!
Every machine has an off switch.

worlds.name: Death Knell
worlds.idea: Reverberate: play the bottom card of the discard twice
worlds.story: The bell tolls twice: the first card you played rings out again from the bottom of your discard pile.

lines: The bell tolls for thee, Reaper!
It tolls for you. I'm just here to collect.
I punch faster than a bullet!
Shrimp for dinner.
Begone, Reaper! This is holy ground!
Perfect. I love a good funeral.
IT'S ALIVE! ...and so am I!
Uhh... not for long.
Full power, coming through!
Let's see how long your battery lasts.
Feed me, Reaper!
Here's a little something.

worlds.name: Reaper's Scythe
worlds.idea: Heavy weapons and Armory's copies of them
worlds.story: The armory of the dead: heavy weapons, and copies of them forged on demand.

lines: I'm red-hot slime!
And I'm about to see red.
Feel the burn!
I don't feel much of anything.
I'm a fun-gi, Reaper!
There's not mushroom for both of us.
I'm a stew that came alive. Don't ask.
ROCK AND ROLL FOREVER!
Forever's a long time. Let's wrap up this set.
None shall pass!
Can your sword beat my scythe, good sir?
dialog.death: Alright... we'll call it a draw...

lines: SQUAWK! I'll chop you down!
Birds of a feather die together.

worlds.name: Soul Trade
worlds.idea: Trade with the enemy and yourself: Cooperation heals them for energy, Exchange swaps your HP and energy
worlds.story: Strike deals with your enemy and yourself: their health for your energy, your health for your energy.

lines: You owe me, Reaper!
Everyone pays me in the end.
Your soul or your life!
That's the same thing.
I'll trade you three souls for yours!
Just 3?? I'm offended.
Flumph! Flumph flumph!
...I'll take that as a yes.

worlds.name: Last Rites
worlds.idea: Nothing left: Empty Fist hits when you have no energy, Parting Shot and Gambit when your hand is empty, Snipe when your discard pile is
worlds.story: Strength from nothing: these cards hit hardest when your energy, your hand or your discard pile is empty.

lines: Squeak... I've lived a long life...
...Put this thing out of its misery.
I'm just hanging around. Not doing anything.
Then you won't mind if I wrap things up.
I fold under no one!
A paper cut? I'm terrified.
Hehe! I break everything!
You little menace, get over here!
I've carried a hundred coffins.
Maybe I could use your help then...
I've rigged everything. You can't win!
I always win.

worlds.name: Balance of Power
worlds.idea: Charge and balance: Capacitor turns an attack into energy, Balance pays off when your HP and energy match, Cleanse wipes your statuses
worlds.story: Keep everything even. Attacks can become energy, and matching your health and energy pays off.

lines: I will judge this fight fairly.
Death is the only fair judge.
Strike me, Reaper! I'll take all of it!
Ok, sure. But it will definitely kill you.
My sting is lethal!
Hehe, that tickles!
I keep everything in perfect balance!
Death is nature's balance.
Fascinating! A real Grim Reaper! Can I take a sample?
Uh, sure, but I don't have to go right now.
I've traded with every empire on earth!
Every empire falls. Hope you have a savings account!

worlds.name: Unmarked Grave
worlds.idea: Raise the dead: Seance trashes the first and last cards in your discard pile and gives you back everything in between
worlds.story: The spirits give back what you played: everything but the first and last cards in your discard pile.

lines: The spirits told me you'd come!
Did they tell you how it ends?
I'm a medium. I talk to the dead!
Ok, tell them hello for me!
I'll take this body. And yours!
Mine's mostly robe.
You'll never find me in the jungle!
I always find everyone.
I feed on the energy of the living!
Then you're going to starve.

worlds.name: Bone Shards
worlds.idea: Fragment: split one attack into many hits
worlds.story: One blow shatters into many small hits, and anything that adds to a hit adds to every shard.

lines: Break me and I just get sharper!
Paper cuts... then splinters... what next?!
ROAR! I'm a fearsome paper tiger!
Paper beats rock. Scythe beats paper.
I grind bones into dust!
*grinder noises*
RIBBIT! I'll swallow you whole!
Hop to it.
Nothing gets through my shield!
Not even my super sharp scythe???

worlds.name: The Final Audit
worlds.idea: The hardest puzzles, using every card.
worlds.story: Every debt comes due: the hardest puzzles in the land, using everything you've learned.

lines: I've burned down kingdoms, Reaper!
And I've collected every one of them.
They made me in a lab. I can't die!
That's... just a theory.
Hee hee! Infinite mana, infinite tricks!
Hands off my goods, imp!
I'll be back.
No, you won't.
I am unbreakable!
Stay still and let me take a few whacks.
By the light, I'll smite you, foul Reaper!
By the light, you'll see me soon.
